info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Hotel Loyalty Points Redeem-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Redemption API enables users to redeem points accumulated through hotel loyalty programs. This service allows customers to seamlessly exchange their points for rewards, discounts, or services, enhancing their overall travel experience. Typical consumers of this API include hotel booking platforms, loyalty program managers, and mobile applications focused on loyalty benefits. By providing a straightforward interface for transactions, this API supports improved customer engagement and retention in the hospitality sector.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to redeem their accumulated points in exchange for various rewards. Users can specify the reward they want to claim by providing the necessary information in the request body. Ensure that sufficient points are available for redemption.

requestBody.description: The request body for redeeming points. This contains the details regarding the redemption request, including the necessary identifiers and the amount of points to be redeemed.

200.description: Request completed successfully, points have been redeemed.

CreateHotelLoyaltyPointsRedeemRequest.title: Redeem Points Request

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the redeem points request.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number for tracking the transaction.

customer.description: Information about the customer making the request.

resource.description: Identifier of the resource associated with the points redemption.

priority.description: Priority level of the request, where lower numbers indicate higher priority.

amount.description: Amount of points to be redeemed.

currency.description: Currency type for the points redemption area.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether notification is required after redeeming points.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the redemption request was made.

channel.description: Channel through which the request is initiated (e.g., web, mobile).

recordIndex.description: Index of the record in the database related to the redemption.

CreateHotelLoyaltyPointsRedeemRequest.description: A request body for redeeming points in the operations API.

Customer.title: Customer Information

Customer.description: Details of the customer involved in the redemption request.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the redemption transaction.

CreateHotelLoyaltyPointsRedeemResponse_2.description: This schema represents the response received after a successful point redemption operation.
